subject: Draft MAP, invoicing cadence & PO timing for Orion evaluation
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@orionhealth.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP, invoicing cadence & PO timing for Orion evaluation

Hi Kate / Samir —

Thanks again for the call today. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_Orion_v1.pdf) and a light SOW (SOW_Orion_v0.3.docx) that tie the evaluation milestones to commercial checkpoints. High-level points for alignment: 

- Evaluation period: 6 weeks (pilot) with success criteria defined on page 2 of the MAP.
- Ramp commitments: initial pilot (no commit), month 1 ramp to 250k tokens, month 2 ramp to 1M tokens to unlock 10% committed discount.
- Pricing: usage rates in SOW; committed discounts apply retroactively when commit thresholds are met in a calendar month.
- Billing start date: proposed to be the production activation date (when Redwood marks the tenant "active-prod") or 30 days after signature, whichever is earlier.
- PO & terms: Redwood standard is Net30 from invoice date. For Dedicated/reserved capacity we require a customer PO prior to the first invoice. For hosted evaluations we can be flexible on PO timing — see questions below.
- Invoicing cadence: monthly in arrears; onboarding/setup charge as a one-time invoice at cutover is possible.

Questions for your finance team so we converge on the contract: 
1) Do you require a PO before the first invoice for evaluation customers, or only for committed/reserved contracts?
2) Can Orion accept Net30? If not, what is your standard (Net45/Net60), and would that be for all invoices or just the first?
3) Would you prefer we split the invoice into onboarding + monthly usage?

Next steps: if the above is acceptable I can circulate a short SOW + signature-ready DocuSign and ask legal to lock Po terms. Laura — can you confirm our PO policy language for evaluations vs dedicated? Marissa — can you draft the HubSpot play with dates?

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (425) 555-0187

Attachments: MAP_Orion_v1.pdf (map summary, milestones); SOW_Orion_v0.3.docx (pricing + terms)

From: Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@orionhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, invoicing cadence & PO timing for Orion evaluation

Thanks Jonas — quick clarifying Qs from finance before we move to signature: 

- Billing start: our procurement policy usually starts billing when a PO is issued and the service is "in production". For pilots we sometimes accept billing at activation, but we need the PO on file. Can you confirm whether Redwood can start invoicing on activation if we provide a PO within 10 business days?

- Terms: standard for enterprise is Net60 on first invoice and then Net30 thereafter, unless we pre-authorize earlier payment. Is that something Redwood can accommodate for the onboarding invoice?

- Invoice split: yes — we prefer a separate one-time onboarding/setup invoice and then monthly usage invoices. That helps our internal charge codes.

Also want to confirm the ramp discount: is the 10% retroactive or forward-looking? We need the language to be explicit.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — cc'ing Samir (ops) to confirm activation acceptance criteria.

Best,
Kate
Kate Johnson
Head of Digital Platforms | Orion Health
kate.johnson@orionhealth.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@orionhealth.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, invoicing cadence & PO timing for Orion evaluation

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear asks. Quick answers from legal/finance: 

- PO requirement: For Hosted evaluations (no reserved capacity) we can accept a PO within 10 business days of the first invoice; we do not require the PO to exist before the activation invoice. For Dedicated/reserved capacity seats we require a PO prior to the first invoice.

- Billing start date: we are flexible. Proposed contract language we can sign to reflect either (a) billing starts on production activation date (Redwood marks tenant "active-prod") or (b) billing starts 30 days after signature. We'll include both as OR options in the SOW and you can pick at signature.

- Net terms: Standard is Net30. We can accommodate Net60 on the first invoice as a one-time concession if Orion's procurement needs that; all subsequent invoices will be Net30. We'll call this out in the SOW as "First-invoice Net60, thereafter Net30."

- Invoice cadence & split: we can issue a one-time onboarding/setup invoice (one-time) and monthly usage invoices in arrears. The onboarding invoice can be issued at activation or on the signature date per your preference.

- Ramp discount mechanics: the 10% discount is retroactive to the beginning of the month in which the commit threshold is hit. For example, if the 1M token commit is achieved during March, usage for March is billed at the discounted rate after reconciliation. We'll include a short reconciliation clause for mid-month adjustments.

I'm attaching the redlined SOW with the above options and suggested language. If those look good to Orion, we can produce a DocuSign package with the chosen billing start option and the PO instructions.

Laura Bennett
Head of Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments referenced: SOW_Orion_v0.3.docx (redlines)

From: Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@orionhealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, invoicing cadence & PO timing for Orion evaluation

Laura — thanks, that reads well. A couple of follow-ups: 

1) We will request Net60 on the first invoice only; confirm that Redwood will set credit terms on the first invoice only and switch to Net30 automatically. We agree to provide a PO within 10 business days of the first invoice for the hosted evaluation.

2) On the onboarding invoice: we prefer it to be issued at activation. If production activation triggers the onboarding invoice, we will route PO + internal approvals to match that timing.

3) Please include the reconciliation example in the SOW so our billing team can see how retroactive discounts will be applied.

4) Final ask: can the onboarding fee be split into two line items (onboarding + one-time extended support) so we can map to two GL codes?

If you can accept the above, we will sign when we receive the DocuSign with the chosen options.

Thanks,
Kate

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Johnson <kate.johnson@orionhealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@orionhealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 5 Dec 2026 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, invoicing cadence & PO timing for Orion evaluation

Kate / Samir — great, we can finalize with the following concrete commitments: 

- PO: Orion will provide a PO within 10 business days of the first invoice for the hosted evaluation. For Dedicated/reserved contracts, PO required before first invoice.
- First invoice terms: Net60 (one-time concession). All subsequent invoices: Net30.
- Invoicing cadence: onboarding/setup invoice (issued at activation) + monthly usage invoices in arrears. Onboarding fee can be split into two line items (onboarding + one-time extended support) per your GL requirement.
- Billing start date: production activation (Redwood marks tenant "active-prod") — this will trigger the onboarding invoice. Alternatively, you can choose the 30-days-after-signature option at signature time; we will include both as selectable options in the DocuSign SOW.
- Ramp discount: 10% retroactive to the month where commit threshold is met; reconciliation example will be included in the SOW.

Next steps: Laura will generate the DocuSign package with the two billing start options selected (we'll default to activation), the split onboarding line items, and the first-invoice Net60 language. I'll open the HubSpot deal and attach the final SOW + MAP.

Thanks — talk soon.
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (425) 555-0187

Related links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/OR-2026-1123 ; DocuSign will follow.
